content: Keriaun Wadawad en Aramas
Mwurin soumwahu lusuluso, KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses oh Eleasar, nein Aaron,
“Kumwa wiahda wadawad en peneinei kan en mehn Israel koaros, ohl koaros me mahkier sounpar rieisek kohda me kak wia doadoahk en sounpei.”

Moses oh Eleasar ahpw kapwaiada, ira eri kapokonepene ohl koaros me mahkier sounpar rieisek kohda. Re ahpw pokonpene nan patapat en Mohap ni keilen Pillap Sordan sallahng Seriko. Iet kan mehn Israel me kohdohsang Isip:
Kadaudok en Reupen (Reupen, iei nein Seikop mesenih): peneineien Anok, Pallu,
Esron oh Karmi.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene 43,730 ohl.
Peneineien Pallu iei Eliap

oh nah pwutak kan iei Nemuel, Dadan, oh Apiram. (Deidan oh Apiram, iei ira me pilipildahr sang rehn mehn Israel kan. Ira me uhwong Moses oh Aaron oh iangala iengen Kora ko ni ahnsou me re kahngohdiong KAUN-O.
Sampah sarapeseng oh kadaleirahla, ira eri mehla iangahki Kora oh ienge ko ni ahnsou me kisiniei karongehla me 250; irail eri wiahla mehn kapar ehu ong aramas akan.
Ahpw nein Kora pwutak ko sohte iang kamakamala.)
Kadaudok en Simion: peneineien Nemuel, Samin, Sakin,
Sera, oh Saul.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 22,200 ohl.
Kadaudok en kad: peneineien Sepon, Aki, Suni,
Osni, Eri,
Arod, oh Areli.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 40,500 ohl.
Kadaudok en Suda: peneineien Sela, Peres, Sera, Esron oh Amul. (Riemen nein Suda pwutak, Er oh Onan, ira mehla nan wehin Kenan).
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 76,500 ohl.
Kadaudok en Isakar: peneineien Tola, Pua,
Sasup oh Simron.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 64,300 ohl.
Kadaudok en Sepulon: peneineien Sered, Elon, oh Sapleel.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 60,500 ohl.
Kadaudok kan en Sosep, me naineki pwutak riemen, Manase oh Epraim.
Kadaudok en Manase. Makir, nein Manase, iei semen Kilead oh peneinei me pahn wad met kan arail pahpa kahlap ako tepisang Kilead:
Peneinei en Ieser, Elek,
Asriel, Sekem,
Semida oh Eper.
Selopehad, nein Eper, sohte nah pwutak ahpw mie nah serepein; adarail iei Mala, Noha, Okla, Milka oh Tirsa.
Peneinei pwutak koaros patpene me 52,700 ohl.
Kadaudok en Epraim: peneineien Sudela, Peker, oh Tahan.
Peneineien Eran tepisang Sudela.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 32,500 ohl. Ih peneinei pwukat me tepisang Sosep.
Kadaudok en Pensamin: peneineien Pela, Aspel, Airam,
Sepupam oh Upam.
Peneineien Ard oh Nahman tepisang Pela.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 45,600 ohl.
Kadaudok en Dan: peneineien Usim,
irail koaros me 64,400 ohl.
Kadaudokk en Aser: peneineien Imna, Ispi, oh Peria.
Peneineien Eper oh Malkiel tepisang Peria.
Aser naineki serepein men ede Sera.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 53,400 ohl.
Kadaudok en Napdali: peneineien Saseel, Kuni,
Seser oh Sillem.
Peneinei pwukat koaros patpene me 45,400 ohl.
Ohlen Israel koaros patpene me 601,730.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanihong Moses,
“Nehkpeseng sahpwo nanpwungen kadaudok pwukat nin duwen tohtohn aramas akan.
Nehnehn sahpwo pahn wiawi ni usuhs, oh sahpw laud pahn kohieng kadaudok laud, oh sahpw tikitik pahn kohieng kadaudok tikitik.”
Kadaudok en Lipai, me towe, peneineien Kerson, Kohad oh Merari.
Kadaudokarail kan iei keimw en peneineien Lipni, Epron, Mali, Musi oh Kora. Kohad iei semen Amram,
me pwoudiki nein Lipai serepein, Sokeped me ipwidi Isip. E wiahiong Amram pwutak riemen, Aaron oh Moses oh serepein men, Miriam.
Aaron naineki pwutak pahmen, Nadap, Apihu, Eleasar oh Idamar.
Nadap oh Apihu mehla ahnsou me ira wiahiong KAUN-O kisiniei me sohte sarawi.
Mehn Lipai ohl me sounpwong ehu kohda koaros patpene me 23,000. Re wadawad tohrohrasang mehn Israel teikan pwehki ar sohte kin ale sohsohn sahpw nan Israel.
Moses oh Eleasar me wia wadawad en peneinei pwukat koaros nan patapat en Mohap ni keilen Pillap Sordan sallahng Seriko.
Sohte ohl emen luhwehdi me iang ntingdier ni wadawad en aramas me Moses oh Aaron wiadahr nan Sapwtehn en Sainai.
KAUN-O ketin mahsanih me irail koaros pahn mehla nan sapwtehn, ihte me soh, Kalep nein Sepune oh Sosua, nein Nun.
